returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.lede: {days} days to change your mind, with collection from your door.
returns.windowBody: Return or exchange anything within {days} days of delivery.
returns.conditionBody: Unworn, unwashed, with tags attached and in its original packaging. Sleepwear and swimwear must be unopened for hygiene.
steps: Message us on WhatsApp with your order reference and the item.
We arrange a collection from your door at a time that suits you.
Once it reaches us, a refund is issued to your original payment method, or the exchange is sent out.
returns.refundBody: Card and KNET refunds appear within 5 to 10 working days depending on your bank. Cash on delivery orders are refunded to a bank account you give us.
returns.exchangeBody: A different size or colour of the same item is exchanged free of charge, subject to stock.
returns.excludedBody: Personalised items, opened sleepwear or swimwear, and items marked final sale.

size-guide.title: Size guide
size-guide.lede: Our sizes follow height first, then age — children grow at their own pace.
size-guide.howBody: Measure standing, without shoes, from the top of the head to the floor. If between two sizes, choose the larger: little ones grow into it.
size-guide.note: A guide, not a rule. If unsure, message us with height and weight and we will point you to the right size.
size-guide.onProductBody: Fit notes for a specific item are on its product page under Details.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lede: The questions we are asked most.

items.a: {window}. Free on orders of {free} or more, otherwise {rate}.

items.q: Can I pay when the order arrives?
items.a: Yes — cash on delivery is available across Kuwait. KNET and cards are also accepted.
Message us on WhatsApp within {days} days of delivery. We collect it from your door and refund or exchange it.

items.q: Are the prams and car seats certified?
items.a: Every pram and car seat we sell meets EU safety standards and comes with the manufacturer's warranty.
Yes. Add a note at checkout and we will wrap it and leave the price off the slip.

items.q: What if an item is out of stock?
items.a: Use "Notify me" on the product page and we will message you the moment it is back.

items.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
items.a: Message us straight away with your reference. If it has not left us, we will change or cancel it.
See the size guide — sizes follow height first. When in doubt, go up a size.
